technical_and_design_decisions: Adopt Spring Cloud Stream as the framework for porting modules to s-c-s repo.
Each module (router, file, FTP, redis, rabbit, gemfire) will be implemented as a separate Spring Cloud Stream application.
Use existing XD module logic as a reference but adapt to Spring Cloud Stream's functional programming model.
Leverage Spring Integration for modules requiring protocol-specific handling (e.g., FTP, Redis).
Ensure compatibility with Java 17+ as required by Spring Framework 6.0.
Integrate modules with existing s-c-s testing infrastructure for unit and integration tests.
assumptions: All modules (router, file, FTP, redis, rabbit, gemfire) follow similar structural patterns in XD and can be ported with comparable effort.
Existing XD module tests can be adapted to s-c-s with minimal rework.
HDP/PHD distro compatibility testing can be performed using available sandbox environments.
Migration documentation will focus on API changes and configuration differences between 1.2 and 1.3.
No major architectural changes are required beyond porting existing functionality.

activities.activity_name: Analyze existing XD modules for all required ports
activities.activity_description: Review and document the logic, dependencies, and configuration of router, file, FTP, redis, rabbit, and gemfire modules in XD.

activities.activity_name: Design module structures for all ports
activities.activity_description: Define the Spring Cloud Stream application structure, bindings, and configuration for each module.
Develop the router, file, FTP, redis, rabbit, and gemfire modules using Spring Cloud Stream and Spring Integration.

activities.activity_name: Write unit tests for all modules
activities.activity_description: Create unit tests for each module's core logic and configuration.
Ensure modules are compatible with the s-c-s repository structure and build system.
Test end-to-end functionality of each module within a streaming pipeline.
Review HDP/PHD distro requirements and identify necessary updates for HDFS integration.
Modify build configurations and dependencies to support latest HDP/PHD releases.
Validate HDFS integration and pipeline functionality with updated HDP/PHD versions.
Identify backward incompatibilities and new features introduced in 1.3.
Document migration steps, configuration changes, and backward incompatibility details.
Validate accuracy and completeness of the migration guide.
